cues.en: Daylight. There's nothing quite like the rising sun to get you ready for your day, and when it enters your home it can transform a dingy room into a vibrant and relaxing space. The warmth of the sun itself in combination with the fresh blue tones of the sky bring a vivid and lively feel to the light, making it utterly unique and something to be treasured. However, despite appearances, this is not actually early morning sunlight.
cues.zh: 日光。没有什么比初升的太阳更能唤醒新的一天了，当阳光洒进房间，哪怕再昏暗的屋子也能变得明亮又惬意。阳光本身的暖意，加上天空那一抹清新的蔚蓝，让光线充满生机与活力，这种独特的美好格外让人留恋。然而，尽管看上去很像，但这其实并不是清晨的阳光。

cues.en: To tell you the truth, it's actually nighttime, and this is an artificial sun. And in this video, I'm going to be showing you exactly how to build one. Everything you see here, from the accurate parallel shadows to the natural blue sky scattering, and even an apparent space of infinite depth behind the window, is all down to a unique design that can even be made out of recycled parts. This is going to be a good one.
cues.zh: 说实话，现在其实是深夜，而这是一个“人造太阳”。在这个视频里，我会一步步教你如何亲手做一个。你在这里看到的一切，从精准的平行阴影，到自然的蓝天散射，甚至是窗外那片看似深不见底的空间，全都归功于这个巧妙的设计，它甚至可以用回收零件来制作。这期内容一定会非常精彩。

cues.en: This video is sponsored by KiwiCo. More about them later. Making a convincing artificial sun does present a few challenges, the first of which is throwing the light source back so that it appears to be at infinity. You see, as the sun is so far away, when its light rays reach Earth, they are practically parallel, which is one of the reasons for the sun's unique illumination characteristics like shadows that don't change in size.
cues.zh: 本视频由 KiwiCo 赞助播出，稍后再详细介绍他们。想要做出逼真的人造太阳确实有些挑战，首先就是要把光源“推远”，让它看起来像是位于无限远处。要知道，太阳距离我们极为遥远，当阳光到达地球时，光线几乎是完全平行的，这也是太阳光独特特性的原因之一，比如投出的阴影大小不会改变。

cues.en: Interestingly, recreating these parallel rays with a local light source isn't particularly difficult, as we can just use a lens. You see, when the lens is placed in front of the light at the lens's focal length, it actually collimates the light rays, which means that it makes them parallel. These newly collimated rays now have some of the characteristics of the sun, namely that the light intensity doesn't change because of distance alone, and shadows don't change in size either, which is super interesting to see.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，用本地光源还原这种平行光其实并不难，加个透镜就能搞定。你看，只要把透镜放在光源前恰好等于焦距的位置，它就能把光线准直，也就是说把它们变成平行光。这些被准直的光线就具备了太阳光的部分特性：光照强度不会仅因距离增加而减弱，投出的阴影大小也不会变，这效果非常神奇。

cues.en: Another fascinating result is that anything at the lens's focal point appears to be pinned at infinity, and appears the same size no matter whether you're close to it or far away, as we observed in my recent DIY projector project. So success, right? Well, to a degree yes, but the diameter of your lens directly dictates the size of your area of projected sunlight.
cues.zh: 另一个绝妙的效果是，任何位于透镜焦点的物体，看起来都像是被固定在了无限远处，无论你离它近还是远，它看起来都一样大，正如我之前在自制投影仪项目里看到的那样。所以这就算成功了吗？某种程度上是的，但透镜的直径直接决定了你投影出的阳光覆盖面积有多大。

cues.en: So you need a massive lens to really get the best out of it if you're using a single point light source. And even if you use lenses of the fennel variety, this can get pretty expensive. And you still have some issues to contend with, such as chromatic aberration, which is the rainbow effect you see at the edges.
cues.zh: 因此，如果用单点光源，想达到最佳效果就得用超大的透镜。即使是用菲涅耳透镜，成本也会变得非常高。而且你还得面对其他问题，比如边缘会出现彩虹纹一样的色差。

cues.en: Thankfully, however, there's another way of collomating the light rays, which is to use a parabolic reflector. This, just like a lens, can take light rays emitted at its focal point and bounce them back, but in a way that collomates them to be perfectly parallel, only this time without any chromatic aberration or distortion. Nice.
cues.zh: 不过幸运的是，准直光线还有另一种方法，那就是使用抛物面反射镜。它和透镜一样，可以把从焦点发出的光线反射回去，并把它们准直成完全平行的光束，而且这一次完全没有色差或畸变。太棒了。

cues.en: Reflectors like this are just as expensive and hard to find as large lenses, however, or so you might assume, until you realise that there might be one already attached to the side of your house. That's right, satellite dishes too are parabolic reflectors, intended to amplify distant radio signals by focusing them onto a single point. They're often off-centre designs, which is why they're frequently oval shapes rather than round.
cues.zh: 不过，像这样的反射器，和大透镜一样又贵又难找——至少你可能这么以为，直到你意识到，也许你家房子侧面就装着一个。没错，卫星天线也是抛物面反射器，用来把远处的无线电信号聚焦到一点，从而增强信号。它们通常采用偏轴设计，所以经常是椭圆形而不是圆形。

cues.en: The best part about utilizing these, though, is that used ones can be had for very cheap, or even free if they're old and need replacing. I'm using a big one here that measures 1.2 meters in diameter, which means that my area of projected artificial sunlight will be the same size as this. However, as you can see, it isn't reflective to visible light, so that's the thing we're going to have to fix first. One important thing to do before proceeding, however, is to give it a good clean.
cues.zh: 不过，用这些东西最大的好处是，二手货非常便宜，甚至如果又旧又该换，还能免费拿到。我这里用的是直径1.2米的大号，这意味着我投射出的人造阳光区域也会这么大。不过如你所见，它对可见光并不反光，所以这是我们先要解决的问题。但开始之前有一件重要的事：先把它好好清洗干净。

cues.en: Now this will get any dirt off, which means that it will be much better for the next step. If yours is super rusty like this one, you'll need to give it a thorough sanding down before applying a rust covering primer. Both of these prepping processes are important because we're going to be using vinyl mirror effect film to give it its required reflectivity. And we're going to cut it into strips so that it's easier to apply.
cues.zh: 这样能去掉所有污垢，下一步就会好做得多。如果你的也像这个一样锈得厉害，就得彻底打磨，再涂防锈底漆。这两步预处理都很重要，因为我们要用乙烯基镜面效果膜来让它具备所需的反射性。我们会把它裁成条状，方便贴上去。

cues.en: Now you might be tempted to use some reflective foil tape here instead, but from my tests the mirror film is significantly more reflective, so is definitely recommended. And you can find links to some in this video's description. It does take quite a while to stick on in strips, but once done you should have something that looks like this. With it now mirrored, it's rather ironically very important to stop any sunlight from ever hitting it, as it could focus this light to a point and start a fire.
cues.zh: 你也许想改用反光铝箔胶带，但我的测试表明，镜面膜的反光性明显更好，所以绝对推荐。视频简介里有一些链接。一条条贴上去确实要花不少时间，但贴完后应该就像这样。现在它已经镜面化了，讽刺的是，非常重要的是别让任何阳光照到它，因为它可能把光聚焦到一点并引发火灾。

cues.en: So, be careful. So, this is looking really promising, but before we can test it out and see whether it's going to successfully collimate light rays, we need to sort out a light source. For this, we are going to be using a high-power LED, and as usual, I recommend that you get one with a CRI of a minimum of 90, but ideally 95, and a colour temperature of 5600K.
cues.zh: 所以，要小心。现在这看起来很有希望，但在测试它能否成功准直光线之前，我们需要先解决光源。这里我们要用一个大功率 LED；和往常一样，我建议选择 CRI 至少 90、最好 95，色温 5600K 的 LED。

cues.en: Now, as these LEDs are so powerful, they do generate heat, which means that they have to be used in combination with a heatsink. Now, thankfully for 100 watt emitters, you can get away with using a computer heatsink, which are super cheap to buy second hand. But for this project, I thought I would go with something a bit more special, and I'm using a 500 watt LED from UG LED. And this is...
cues.zh: 现在，这些 LED 功率这么大，确实会发热，所以必须配合散热器使用。幸运的是，对于 100 瓦的发光体，用电脑散热器就够了，二手买非常便宜。但这个项目我想用点更特别的，我用的是 UG LED 的 500 瓦 LED。而这个……

cues.en: obviously very bright, but also it gets hot. So it's accompanying heatsink is unfortunately way oversized, very heavy, and very loud as well with the internal fan. So instead of using this massive heatsink, which would probably bend the satellite dishes support arm, I'm going to be instead water cooling the LED.
cues.zh: 显然它非常亮，但发热量也很大。所以配套的散热片不仅体积过大，非常重，而且内置风扇的声音也特别吵。因此我打算改用冷水散热来冷却 LED，而不是用这个笨重的散热片，不然它很可能会压弯卫星天线的支撑臂。

cues.en: and the set of components I have here are from AlphaCool, and I'm going to be introducing them and their function as I go along. The first component we're going to utilise is a water block, which internally has a lot of tiny fins that the water rushes through, taking heat away from the bottom plate. To interface this well with the LED and ensure good heat transfer, some thermal compound can be used, and then the whole thing can be clamped together with a custom bracket.
cues.zh: 我这里的这套水冷组件来自 AlphaCool，稍后我会边做边介绍它们及其功能。我们首先要用到的部件是水冷头，它内部有很多微小的鳍片，水流冲过时会带走底板的热量。为了让它与 LED 紧密贴合以保证良好的热传导，可以涂上一些导热膏，然后用定制支架把它们整体夹紧固定在一起。

cues.en: Now, this is actually going to be mounted in place of the satellite's original receiver. So after removing the original receiver, a small bracket can be made out of a short length of aluminium angle which allows the LED to be mounted in place of the original receiver at the same position and angle.
cues.zh: 接下来，它其实是要安装在卫星天线原本的高频头接收器位置。所以在拆下原装接收器后，可以用一小段角铝制作一个小支架，这样就能把 LED 固定在原接收器的相同位置和角度上了。

cues.en: If you're using a lower power LED and just want to use a heatsink, this process is pretty much identical, and to power the LED you can just use a voltage regulator and an AC adapter. And this is a very good low-cost way of getting a lot of light output. However, as I'm using a much more powerful LED and water cooling, the process is a little bit more involved. And to get water to and from my LED, there are some standard plumbing fittings on the back of the water block which are
cues.zh: 如果你用的是功率较低的 LED，且只想用普通散热片，那么制作过程基本是一样的，供电方面只需一个稳压器和一个电源适配器即可。这是一种低成本获取超高亮度的绝佳方式。不过，由于我用的是功率大得多的 LED 并且采用水冷，步骤就会稍微繁琐一些。为了实现 LED 处的进出水循环，水冷头背面带有一些标准的管道接头，

cues.en: some compression fittings to be used to securely mount some rubber tubing in place, which can then be routed down the arm along with the LED's power wire. As the power supply I'm using for my LED is super solid and heavy, not to mention waterproof, I made some custom brackets to mount the pump and reservoir combo unit directly to it, followed by the radiator. This can be hooked up to the pump's inlet using a short length of tubing.
cues.zh: 可以用快拧接头牢牢固定住橡胶软管，然后将水管与 LED 的电源线一起沿着支撑臂布置下去。因为我给 LED 配的电源非常结实且沉重，更不用说还防水，所以我制作了几个定制支架，把水泵和水箱的一体式单元直接安装在电源上，接着再装上冷排。用一小段软管就能把它连接到水泵的进水口。

cues.en: The pump's outlet can now be connected straight up to the LED's water block and then returned through the radiator, completing the loop. So the last thing to do now is to fill it up. This process can take a while as it needs to be done bit by bit, running the pump in bursts to push the water into the loop. If you ever do this yourself, be careful to never run it dry as it relies on water for lubrication and it will likely get damaged if it's run without water in it.
cues.zh: 现在把水泵的出水口直接连到 LED 的水冷头上，然后再回流穿过冷排，这样整个水路循环就完成了。接下来最后一步就是加注冷却液。这个过程需要耗费一些时间，因为得一点一点来，通过断断续续地启动水泵把水推入循环回路中。如果你自己动手做，千万注意不要干烧，因为水泵依靠水来润滑，无水空转极易损坏。

cues.en: So, with water rushing through now without any air pockets, some fans can be added to the radiator and the LED is ready to try out. Honestly, I forgot just how bright this LED is. Pretty incredible for being a single light source. But now it's time to mount it onto the satellite.
cues.zh: 现在水流顺畅运转且没有气泡了，就可以在冷排上装上风扇，准备测试一下这颗 LED。说实话，我都忘了这颗 LED 到底有多亮了。作为单一光源来说，效果简直不可思议。不过现在是时候把它安装到卫星天线上了。

cues.en: To make a support for this I screwed some pieces of wood together to make a triangular shape which made it fairly easy to lift the satellite dish up into position. So as you can see I've actually mounted the satellite dish upside down and this is so that we can get a steeper angle on the light output so it appears like it's coming from the sky and not the ground and there are some really promising results actually from the reflection coming off the mirror because the LED itself appears to stay
cues.zh: 为了给它做个支架，我用螺丝把几块木头固定在一起，做成三角形，这样就比较容易把卫星天线抬到位。所以如你所见，我其实把卫星天线倒着装了上去，这样可以让出射光的角度更陡，看起来像是从天上而不是地面来的；而且镜子反射出来的效果其实很有希望，因为 LED 本身看起来还是

cues.en: the same size. So that does indicate to me that it is actually collimating the light. But we're really just going to have to try it out and see whether it works. So I haven't actually tried this yet, so I'm a little bit nervous. Right, are you ready? Here we go. OK, whoa. Oh, wow. OK, you can't see this because you're probably blinded by the light. But yeah, let me show you. As you can see, we have got.
cues.zh: 同样大小。所以这确实向我表明，它实际上是在准直光线。不过我们真的只能试一试，看看它是否有效。其实我还没试过这个，所以有点紧张。好，你准备好了吗？开始吧。好，哇。哦，哇。好，你可能被光晃得看不清，所以看不到这个。不过，让我给你看看。如你所见，我们已经得到了

cues.en: parallel rays. If I move my hand close to the wall, its shadow doesn't change in size, no matter where I am in the room, which is pretty impressive. Now, if I look in the general direction of the light source, it does look like it's at infinity, which is super impressive. I can't look at it directly because it is a bit too bright, but just looking in the general direction of the satellite makes it seem apparent that it's in the distance, which is super cool. And what's more,
cues.zh: 平行光线。如果我把手靠近墙，不管我在房间哪个位置，它的影子大小都不变，这相当厉害。现在，如果我朝光源的大致方向看，它确实看起来像是在无限远处，这非常厉害。我不能直视它，因为有点太亮，但只是朝卫星天线的方向看，就已经很明显它像是在远处，这超酷。而且，

cues.en: It's absolutely pouring with rain outside, which might seem irrelevant, but the thing is, it's all sunny in here. For a bit more space, I've actually moved the satellite dish out into the hallway, and as you can see, the effect is really quite remarkable. This feels and looks just like daylight, and looking at the light, not directly, of course, through the door, it does appear to be extremely far away, so mission accomplished.
cues.zh: 外面正下着倾盆大雨，这看起来可能无关紧要，但问题是，这里面却阳光明媚。为了多腾出一点空间，我其实把卫星天线搬到了走廊里，如你所见，效果真的相当惊人。这感觉和看起来都像日光，而看着那光——当然不是直视，而是透过门看——它确实显得极其遥远，所以任务完成。

cues.en: But there is one thing missing, which is of course the blue sky effect, which is fairly significant because the sunlight look will only properly come into fruition when the sky adds soft blue illumination to the room. So that's the thing we're going to have to sort out next. But before we get on with that, it's time for a quick ad from this video's sponsor, KiwiCo. KiwiCo makes super cool hands-on projects and toys that are not only fun to construct.

So they're a great resource for learning at home. cues.zh: 而且也非常有教育意义，因为它们旨在向孩子们介绍 STEAM 中的概念，也就是科学、技术、工程、艺术和数学。所以它们是居家学习的好资源。每一套都包含每个项目所需的一切，因此完全自成一体，配有详细、适合孩子的说明，以及一本教育杂志，里面内容丰富，可以更深入了解每个套盒的主题。

cues.en: So, thank you KiwiCo for sponsoring this video, and don't forget to check them out with the link below. So, thanks to the satellite dish, our artificial sun is now at infinity, reproducing parallel rays that look and feel like sunlight. The real challenge for this build, however, is going to be mimicking a blue sky.
cues.zh: 非常感谢 KiwiCo 对本期视频的赞助，大家也别忘了点击下方链接去看看。多亏了这个卫星天线，我们的人造太阳现在相当于处于无穷远处，还原出了观感和质感都如同真太阳光一般的平行光线。不过，这个制作真正的挑战，其实在于模拟出蓝天。

cues.en: You see, the reason why the sky appears blue is because molecules in the Earth's atmosphere actually bounce some of the light rays that are coming in from the Sun off their initial path, which is a process known as Rayleigh scattering. As this has a greater effect on shorter wavelengths, blue light gets scattered quite a bit, while red light, for example, can pass through without being affected as much.
cues.zh: 你看，天空之所以呈现蓝色，是因为地球大气层中的分子会把太阳射入的部分光线从原本的路径上弹开，这个过程被称为瑞利散射。因为这种效应在短波长光上更为显著，蓝光会被大量散射，而像红光这样的光线则受影响较小，可以直接穿透过去。

cues.en: This results in some of the white light from the sun diffusing into what we see as blue sky, leaving the sun itself to look more yellowy and warm as a result due to some of its blue light being scattered outwards. A great experiment for observing a similar effect at home can be done by getting a glass of warm water and dipping in a little bit of soap.
cues.zh: 这导致太阳发出的一部分白光弥散开来，形成了我们看到的蓝天，而太阳本身由于一部分蓝光被散射掉了，看起来就会偏黄且显得更温暖。在家里观察类似效应的一个绝佳实验，就是倒一杯温水，然后蘸进一点点肥皂。

cues.en: As the soap dissolves into the water, it begins to scatter light in a similar way to the sky, making it look somewhat bluish. Looking through to a light directly behind it results in the light appearing more orange because a lot of its shorter wavelengths are getting scattered.
cues.zh: 随着肥皂在水中溶解，它就会以类似天空的方式开始散射光线，使水看起来带点微蓝。而透过这杯水直接去看后面的光源，光源就会显得更偏橙色，因为大部分短波长的光都被散射掉了。

cues.en: This smaller scale phenomenon is known as the Tyndall effect, as it relies on much larger particles compared to Rayleigh scattering and can be seen in common materials such as HDPE milk cartons and opalescent glass. Now one of the best ways of achieving this effect would be to use nanoparticles mixed into some sort of epoxy resin.
cues.zh: 这种较小尺度的现象被称为丁达尔效应，与瑞利散射相比，它依赖的是更大的颗粒，在 HDPE 牛奶盒和乳白玻璃等常见材料中都能看到。要实现这种效果，最好的方法之一就是将纳米粒子混合到某种环氧树脂中。

cues.en: However, despite a ton of research, I haven't been able to find a good source of nanoparticles that work as well as this. So if you guys have any suggestions, do let me know in the comments down below. But for this project, my conclusion is that the best way is to simply use soap and water, as it's simple, safe and effective. However, how are we going to get water into the shape of a window? Well, we're just going to mimic a fish tank.
cues.zh: 不过，尽管做了大量研究，我还是没找到能像这个一样好用的纳米颗粒来源。所以如果你们有任何建议，请在下方评论区告诉我。但在这个项目里，我的结论是：最好的办法就是直接用肥皂和水，因为简单、安全又有效。可是，我们怎么让水变成窗户的形状呢？那就模仿鱼缸吧。

cues.en: For this we'll need two sheets of tempered glass, and I suggest using an online calculator to work out what thickness you need for the size of your window. While it would be possible to glue these together with a spacer to make a 4mm deep watertight chamber, I'm instead going to be using a gasket and clamp the two pieces together with some 3D printed holders along with some washers and bolts.
cues.zh: 为此我们需要两块钢化玻璃。我建议用在线计算器算一下，你的窗户尺寸需要多厚的玻璃。虽然可以用垫片把它们粘起来，做成4毫米深的水密腔室，但我改用密封垫，并用几个3D打印固定件、垫圈和螺栓把两块玻璃夹紧。

cues.en: The plan here is to mount it directly to the back of a sheet of MDF, which has been painted to match the wall colour so that it blends in nicely around the door frame, with the satellite dish behind it in the hallway. Watching for any leaks, some distilled water can now be siphoned into the chamber, making it ready for our soap mix.
cues.zh: 这里的计划是把它直接装到一块中密度纤维板背面。这块板已刷成和墙面一样的颜色，好让它在门框周围自然融入，而卫星天线就在后面的走廊里。现在可以一边留意是否漏水，一边把蒸馏水虹吸进腔室，为我们的肥皂混合液做好准备。

cues.en: I ran out of distilled water at this point though, so instead I used filtered tap water. This does increase the likelihood of soap scum forming after a day or two though, which will need to be filtered out in a couple of passes over a couple of days, though this would be good practice to do even if you used distilled water here. And you may want to add a drop of biocide if you're going for extreme longevity. With the mix ready, it can be injected into the window with a plastic syringe. Look at that!
cues.zh: 不过这时我的蒸馏水用完了，所以改用了过滤过的自来水。这确实会增加一两天后形成皂垢的可能性，需要在几天内分几次过滤掉；不过即使你用的是蒸馏水，这样做也是个好习惯。如果你想让它用超长时间，还可以加一滴杀菌剂。混合液准备好后，就可以用塑料注射器注入窗户。看这个！

cues.en: As the soap enters the chamber, we can observe it instantly scattering the light from an LED I placed behind the glass. When you're doing this, I do suggest that you use the proper artificial sunlight to preview this instead, but I wanted to leave it for a big reveal. Over 24 hours, the soap mix will spread out and become evenly distributed, so why not in the meantime finish the scene off with some light curtains to make it look a bit more authentic? Right, are you guys ready?
cues.zh: 当肥皂液进入腔室时，我们可以看到它立刻散射了我在玻璃后面放的LED光。你做这个的时候，我确实建议用合适的人造阳光来预览效果，但我想把它留到正式揭晓。24小时内，肥皂混合液会扩散并均匀分布，那为什么不趁这段时间用几片薄窗帘把场景布置完，让它看起来更真实一点呢？好了，你们准备好了吗？

cues.en: Here we go. Whoa! Look at that! Look at that! That really does feel like daylight. Goodness me! With the blue sky in place, the light suddenly becomes full of life and vibrancy, thanks in part to the sun taking on a warmer hue due to the scattering, with the rest of the room being lit softly by cooler blue tones.
cues.zh: 来了。哇！看这个！看这个！真的像日光一样。天哪！蓝天一到位，光线突然充满生机和活力，部分原因是散射让太阳带上更暖的色调，而房间其余部分则被更冷的蓝色调柔和照亮。

cues.en: This has a dramatic effect on the overall feel of the light, and it now genuinely fools your brain into thinking that it's seeing, specifically, early morning sunlight. Both the parallel rays and their subsequent scattering are necessary for this effect, and neither will work without the other, so it makes for a perfect combination. Now, one of the most remarkable things about this light, I would say, is the way it makes you feel.
cues.zh: 这对整体光感有戏剧性的影响，现在真能让你的大脑以为看到的就是清晨阳光。平行光线和随后的散射对这个效果都必不可少，缺一不可，所以这是个完美的组合。我觉得，这种光最了不起的地方之一，就是它带给你的感受。

cues.en: It's actually nighttime right now, and it's so close to real daylight that it's completely fooled my brain, and I feel fresh and awake, and I'm doing the editing right now, so that's kind of important. But I would imagine that something like this would be really helpful for people with seasonal affective disorder, which is where people feel really depressed in the winter months, where there's not much sunshine.
cues.zh: 现在其实已经是晚上了，但这光线太接近真正的日光了，完全骗过了我的大脑，让我感觉神清气爽、非常清醒，而我现在正在剪辑视频，所以这还挺重要的；不过我想，这种东西对患有季节性情绪失调的人应该会很有帮助，也就是人们在日照很少的冬季月份里会感到非常抑郁的那种情况。

cues.en: And, you know, this being basically the same as real daylight should really boost people's moods. So it could be quite useful in that kind of situation, I'd have thought. But even just for a normal person, it just feels so vivid and full of life that every home should have one of these, especially in the long winter months, because, honestly, it's incredible. I wish I could convey it.
cues.zh: 而且，你知道的，这基本上和真正的日光一样，应该能极大地改善人们的心情；所以我觉得在这种情况下它会非常有用；但即便只是对普通人来说，它感觉也是如此生动且充满生机，以至于每个家庭都应该备上一个，尤其是在漫长的冬季里，因为说实话，它太不可思议了，我真希望能传达出它的妙处。

cues.en: Enough to you, but hopefully my enthusing about it has done that. But you really do have to see it in person to truly appreciate it, but it's truly remarkable. Photographers and filmmakers would also benefit hugely from a light like this, as I know that from my own work here on YouTube, it's going to be a real help to my filming.
cues.zh: 传达得足够到位，不过希望我的热情已经做到了这一点；但你真的必须亲眼所见才能真正领会它的好，它确实非常惊艳；摄影师和电影制作人也能从这种灯光中极大地受益，因为就我自己在 YouTube 上的创作经验来看，它对我的拍摄将会有极大的帮助。

cues.en: So, I hope you've all found this video interesting, and I hope my enthusiasm about this artificial sunlight has come over sufficiently enough, because it really is incredible, and it's been such a long-standing idea that they've had in my head that it's just so wonderful to see it come into fruition. And I hope you agree that it was worth the wait.
cues.zh: 所以，希望大家觉得这个视频很有趣，也希望我对这人造日光的狂热之情已经充分传达出去了，因为它真的很不可思议，而且这是我脑海中构思已久的念头，能看到它最终成真感觉真是太棒了；希望你们也觉得这份等待是值得的。

cues.en: So, many thanks must go out to every one of you for watching this video, and if you enjoy my content, please don't forget to subscribe. And if you want to support the channel financially, you can find the channel's Patreon account at patreon.com slash DIY perks, and many thanks if you decide to support me on there. But other than that, I'm Matt, you've been watching DIY Perks, and I hope to see you next time. Goodbye for now. So good.
cues.zh: 非常感谢观看本期视频的每一位朋友，如果你喜欢我的内容，请别忘了点击订阅；如果你想在经济上支持本频道，可以在 patreon.com 斜杠 DIY perks 找到本频道的 Patreon 账号，如果你决定在那里赞助我，我将不胜感激；除此之外，我是 Matt，你收看的是 DIY Perks，希望我们下次再见；先拜拜啦，真棒。
